interaction.focusVisible: 3px solid #f06449 with 3px offset; search focus-within uses an ink border and a 3px signal-tinted ring.
interaction.pointer: Hourly SVG pointer movement selects the nearest hour; the transparent native range input provides keyboard and assistive interaction.
interaction.press: Location, unit, recovery, and search-result controls scale to 0.97.
interaction.hover: Hover treatments are restricted to hover-capable fine pointers.
interaction.searchKeyboard: Enter chooses the first result and Escape closes the list.

liveRegions: Notices and retained-forecast errors use status roles.
semantics: Search input is an expanded-state combobox controlling a listbox.
The hourly chart has an accessible title and description.
Decorative atmosphere and non-informative icons are hidden from assistive technology.
accessibility.motion: prefers-reduced-motion disables smooth scrolling and collapses animations and transitions.
accessibility.screenReaderUtility: A reusable visually hidden class preserves labels and loading text.

components.name: Search Field
components.description: The 46px city search instrument with leading icon, clear action, and visible focus-within state.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"></circle><path d="m20 20-3.5-3.5"></path></svg><input aria-label="Search for a city or place" placeholder="Search a city"><button type="button" aria-label="Clear search">×</button></label>

components.name: Location Button
components.description: A bordered geolocation instrument that becomes icon-only on mobile.
components.css: .ds-location{display:inline-flex;height:46px;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:0 15px;border:1px solid rgba(20,38,46,.18);border-radius:12px;background:transparent;color:#14262e;font:400 1rem 'Spline Sans Variable',sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 130ms ease,background-color 160ms ease,border-color 160ms ease}.ds-location svg{width:18px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.8}.ds-location:hover{border-color:rgba(20,38,46,.38);background:rgba(255,255,255,.34)}.ds-location:active{transform:scale(.97)}.ds-location:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #f06449;outline-offset:3px}.ds-location:disabled{cursor:wait;opacity:.55}

components.name: Temperature Unit Switch
components.description: A compact two-segment Celsius/Fahrenheit control with an ink-filled active state.
components.css: .ds-unit{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;width:94px;padding:3px;border:1px solid rgba(20,38,46,.38);border-radius:12px;font-family:'Spline Sans Variable',sans-serif}.ds-unit button{min-height:36px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:transparent;color:#53686f;font:inherit;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 130ms ease,color 160ms ease,background-color 160ms ease}.ds-unit button.is-active{background:#14262e;color:#f5f7f4}.ds-unit button:active{transform:scale(.97)}.ds-unit button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #f06449;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Primary Recovery Button
components.description: The high-emphasis retry action used in the blocking forecast error state.
components.html: <button class="ds-primary" type="button"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 11a8 8 0 1 0-2.3 5.7"></path><path d="M20 4v7h-7"></path></svg>Try again</button>

components.name: Notice Banner
components.description: A recoverable status band for denied geolocation and retained-forecast errors.
components.html: Location access was denied. Search for a place instead.
components.css: .ds-notice{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid rgba(20,38,46,.38);border-radius:12px;background:rgba(245,247,244,.88);color:#14262e;font:400 1rem 'Spline Sans Variable',sans-serif}.ds-notice button{padding:5px 8px;border:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;font:inherit;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px;cursor:pointer}.ds-notice button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #f06449;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Search Result Row
components.description: A two-line location option with a bold place name and muted administrative detail.

components.name: Hourly Trace
components.description: The signature strip-recorder chart combining a signal temperature trace, precipitation bars, ruled ticks, and a selected reading line.
components.html: 1:00 AM25°C11% rain

components.name: Daily Forecast Row
components.description: A ruled ledger row aligning day, condition, precipitation probability, and high/low temperature.
components.css: .ds-day{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr 1.55fr .7fr .55fr;gap:24px;align-items:center;min-height:82px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(20,38,46,.18);color:#14262e;font:400 1rem 'Spline Sans Variable',sans-serif;transition:padding 180ms ease,background-color 180ms ease}.ds-date,.ds-temp{display:flex;align-items:center}.ds-date{gap:16px}.ds-date strong{min-width:88px}.ds-date span,.ds-condition,.ds-rain,.ds-temp span{color:#53686f}.ds-rain,.ds-temp{font-family:'Azeret Mono Variable',monospace;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-temp{justify-content:end;gap:16px}.ds-temp strong{font-size:1.25rem}.ds-day:hover{padding-inline:14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.34)}

narrative.overview:
Weather Window translates a contemporary meteorological recorder into a responsive web instrument. A pale atmospheric field carries deep ink type, ruled divisions, calibrated data marks, and one warm condition-led signal. The interface is calm and operational rather than decorative: current conditions form a strong register, the next 24 hours run as a continuous trace, and the week reads as an indexed ledger.

The visual world changes with the weather without changing its information architecture. Surface, ink, signal, water, and atmospheric colors shift through seven condition classes while typography, geometry, hierarchy, and interaction stay stable. Controls are compact and tactile, numeric data is precisely aligned, and depth is reserved for overlays and atmospheric emphasis rather than a field of floating cards.
keyCharacteristics: Pale, condition-responsive atmospheric fields with deep, high-contrast ink.
An oversized vertical current register anchored by mono weather numerals.
A continuous hourly strip trace with ruled ticks, rain bars, and a movable reading line.
Seven-day forecasts organized as full-width indexed rows instead of cards.
Compact instrument controls with visible focus and immediate press feedback.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Use one condition-led signal color for the trace and selected or emphasized instrument details; do not scatter unrelated accents across the forecast.

rules.name: The Numeric Instrument Rule
rules.body: Temperatures, times, percentages, and measured values use Azeret Mono with tabular numerals; descriptive weather language stays in Spline Sans.

rules.name: The Flat Field Rule
rules.body: Forecast regions stay on one continuous field and are separated with rules, spacing, and tone; do not turn them into a grid of floating glass cards.

dos: Do preserve the continuous ruled forecast field and use spacing, lines, and alignment before adding containers.
Do let weather conditions remap the existing semantic color roles while keeping hierarchy and interactions stable.
Do use Spline Sans for language and Azeret Mono with tabular numerals for measured data.
Do keep keyboard focus visible, expose live data changes politely, and retain the native range input over the hourly trace.
Do limit hover treatments to devices that report a fine pointer and stop or collapse motion for reduced-motion users.
donts: Don't replace the current register, hourly trace, or daily ledger with interchangeable glass cards.
Don't introduce extra accent colors when the active signal and water roles already encode emphasis and precipitation.
Don't compress the hourly trace into an unreadable mobile sparkline; preserve its width and allow horizontal scrolling.
Don't use mono typography for descriptive conditions or long-form interface copy.
Don't add decorative motion that competes with reading the forecast or survives the reduced-motion override.
